tools.name: journal_pack
tools.description: $0.05 USDC. Three to fourteen days of prompts. Optional goal and days.

tools.name: coaching

tools.name: selftalk

tools.name: affirmations

tools.name: affirmations_audio

tools.name: content_pack
tools.description: $0.07 USDC. Five social posts, three hooks, a caption, and hashtags.

tools.name: search
tools.description: $0.02 USDC. One web search. Not charged if search fails or finds nothing.

tools.name: research_pack
tools.description: $0.10 USDC. Up to 3 searches and 8 snippet sources. Not charged if nothing usable comes back.

tools.name: offer_normalize
tools.description: $0.05 USDC. Normalize up to three pasted offers. No URL is fetched.

tools.name: claim_audit
tools.description: $0.04 USDC. Check claims against excerpts you supply. No page is fetched.

tools.name: invoice_check
tools.description: $0.03 USDC. Check a supplied invoice. Unknown amounts are not treated as zero.

tools.name: quote_invoice_check
tools.description: $0.05 USDC. Compare a supplied quote or purchase order with a later invoice, line by line. Flags quantity, unit price, missing and extra lines, tax, and total mismatches. Text is untrusted and is not fetched. Not accounting or legal advice.

tools.name: vendor_check
tools.description: $0.04 USDC. Public-data brief on a vendor domain for an invoice or payment workflow: RDAP age and registrar, DNS, SPF and DMARC, and the TLS certificate or Certificate Transparency. Domains only. Not a security audit or a KYB guarantee.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
